utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that right? What do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly batteries, a few extension cords, and some heavy-duty tape. I can keep an ear out if anything else gets added to the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a big help. I might miss a few details, so please remind me when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll remind you as soon as the time and place are locked in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I may take you up on that. I’m heading out to run a few errands, so I’ll check in after I see how the repair drive is going.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just text me when you’re back and I’ll check in on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What kind of repairs are you hoping to get organized?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly small home fixes—things like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and patching up doors. I’m just trying to match folks with the right supplies and a few handy neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. I can help match people with supplies, and I know a couple of handy neighbors who might pitch in too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive. What time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be so helpful, Faye — maybe we can aim for 3 to 5 pm so folks can swing by after pickup?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3 to 5 pm sounds good to me — I can help spread the word and line it up around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s keep it simple—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli—could you bring a few basic tools and help sort the donations? I might forget a step or two, but I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll bring a basic tool kit and help sort the donations. Just send me the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you want, I can also bring a few neighbors over to help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, thank you. Just please keep it simple so we can sort out the timing and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep it simple and let everyone know the basics. Then we can line up timing and supplies together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon — is there anything folks still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we could still use a few hands for setup and a couple more folks willing to help with small repairs. If you know anyone handy, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll ask around and send anyone handy your way. Do you want me to pass along what time setup starts?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the details for the repair drive first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details over right now so you have everything in one place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll wait for the details and review them carefully before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can pitch in a little, but I’ll need to keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — thanks for pitching in quietly. I’ll let you know the details, and you can jump in when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Just send me the details when you can, and I’ll do my part quietly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a few tools if that helps with the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — do you have a drill and a set of screwdrivers I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both you can borrow. Swing by whenever you’re ready and I’ll grab them for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping track of the repair drive location — where should I head next?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Head over to the community center — that’s where the repair drive is set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll head to the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really kind, Gus. I’d appreciate the help with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — I’ve got a toolbox ready, and I can bring it by when you need it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and how we’ll get everything there. Do we know who’s bringing the supplies and what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we know for sure who’s bringing the supplies and when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet—I think we should confirm both before we promise anything. If you want, I can check on the supplies and start time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — we still need a few more volunteers for the Saturday sign-in table and someone to help sort donated tools. If you’re free, I’d be grateful for either one.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can take the Saturday sign-in table, and I’m happy to help sort the donated tools too if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a rough count of supplies for the repair drive, but I haven’t sorted everything yet. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late as usual, but I can help sort the extra supplies. What are you still short on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still short on screws, duct tape, and a couple of work gloves. If you can help sort, I’ll check what’s left and set aside the extras.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—people have been dropping off tools and supplies already. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, thanks, Tess. I’m trying to work it around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the time and location. I’ll make sure it’s something you can fit around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just point me to the drop-off, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — the drop-off is at the community center entrance, and I’ll be there to help unload. If you can label anything fragile, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll label anything fragile and bring it by the community center entrance. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Leo—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring a drill and some spare screws? I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll bring a drill and some spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard about the repair drive—sounds like a great chance to pitch in. Want me to spread the word and see who can help?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be really helpful, thanks—I’m still catching up on who’s around. If you hear anything, let me know and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll ask around and let you know who can help out. If you need anything else in the meantime, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where the repair drive is happening—what location do you need?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: where is it being held, and what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s being held at the community center, and you can come by at 3:00 PM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, I think so, but let me double-check the time and what we’re bringing before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you confirm the time and whether I should bring tools or just supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep checking around here too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll circle back if I hear anything useful while I’m out.
